pairs.target: huíqù bǔ shuō nà dào lán , bǐ tǎ wéi yǐwéi de fèishí .
pairs.english: Going back to mention that railing took longer than Tavi expected.
pairs.hanzi: 回去补说那道栏，比塔维以为的费时。

pairs.target: zhǎngguì wèn fēng le duōjiǔ , gūniáng wèn yáng yǒuméiyǒu gǎnshànglái , nài lěi zhǐnéng bǎ zìjǐ tīngjiàn de yuánhuà zàishuō yíbiàn .
pairs.english: The proprietor asked how long it had been closed, the girl asked whether the sheep had been brought up, and Nerai could only repeat the very words she had heard once more.
pairs.hanzi: 掌柜问封了多久，姑娘问羊有没有赶上来，奈蕾只能把自己听见的原话再说一遍。

pairs.target: děng tāmen chóngxīn zǒushàng jiē , diànménkǒu de yǐngzi yǐjīng yuèguò bànfú lùmiàn .
pairs.english: By the time they walked back onto the street, the shadow at the shop entrance had already crossed half the roadway.
pairs.hanzi: 等他们重新走上街，店门口的影子已经越过半幅路面。

pairs.target: nài lěi bùkěn zài cóng qiáo shàng rào , dài tā yánzhe shuǐshēng xià le yíduàn shíjiē .
pairs.english: Nerai refused to detour over the bridge again and led him down a flight of stone steps, following the sound of water.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾不肯再从桥上绕，带他沿着水声下了一段石阶。

pairs.target: " zhèbiān jìn ? "
pairs.english: “Is this way shorter?”
pairs.hanzi: “这边近？”

pairs.target: " zhèbiān yǒu chī de . "
pairs.english: “This way has food.”
pairs.hanzi: “这边有吃的。”

pairs.target: tā shuō de hěn gāncuì , tǎ wéi biàn bǎ yuánxiān de wèntí yàn le huíqù .
pairs.english: She spoke very decisively, so Tavi swallowed his original question.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得很干脆，塔维便把原先的问题咽了回去。

pairs.target: shíjiē jìntóu shì yìtiáo xiáchángde shuǐqú , jǐzhī píngdǐchuán tiēzhe shí àn tíngkào .
pairs.english: At the end of the steps was a long narrow canal, with several flat-bottomed boats moored against the stone bank.
pairs.hanzi: 石阶尽头是一条狭长的水渠，几只平底船贴着石岸停靠。

pairs.target: duìàn de fángzi cóng shuǐbiān yìcéngcéng zhǎng shàngqù , chuāngwài liàngzhe yīshang .
pairs.english: The houses across the canal grew up tier upon tier from the water, with clothes hung outside their windows.
pairs.hanzi: 对岸的房子从水边一层层长上去，窗外晾着衣裳。

pairs.target: zuìgāochù zhǐ shèng wūjǐ hé tiān , tǎ wéi fēnbùqīng nǎ yíduàn shì jiē , nǎ yíduàn shì biérén jiā de yuànqiáng .
pairs.english: At the very top only roof ridges and sky remained; Tavi could not distinguish which stretch was a street and which stretch was someone else's courtyard wall.
pairs.hanzi: 最高处只剩屋脊和天，塔维分不清哪一段是街，哪一段是别人家的院墙。

pairs.target: ànbiān mài rè bǐng de fùrén ná zhe cháng jiā , xiān bǎ yígè jiāohēi de bǐng tuī dào pángbiān .
pairs.english: The woman selling hot flatbreads on the bank held long tongs and first pushed one charred bread aside.
pairs.hanzi: 岸边卖热饼的妇人拿着长夹，先把一个焦黑的饼推到旁边。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhǐzhe nàge , shuō piányi xiē biàn mǎi .
pairs.english: Nerai pointed to that one, saying she would buy it if it were cheaper.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾指着那个，说便宜些便买。

pairs.target: fùrén shuō dǐxià hēi le , xīnlǐ háishì hǎo de , liǎnggè rén biàn wèi zhè kē hǎoxīn zhí duōshǎo qián zhēng qǐlái .
pairs.english: The woman said the bottom was black but its heart was still good, so the two of them argued about how much money this good heart was worth.
pairs.hanzi: 妇人说底下黑了，心里还是好的，两个人便为这颗好心值多少钱争起来。

pairs.target: zuìhòu nài lěi mǎi le liǎnggè , jiāohēi de nàge piányi yìdiǎn , què yě méi piányi dào tā xiǎngyào de jiàqián .
pairs.english: In the end Nerai bought two; the charred one was a little cheaper, but still not as cheap as the price she wanted.
pairs.hanzi: 最后奈蕾买了两个，焦黑的那个便宜一点，却也没便宜到她想要的价钱。

pairs.target: tā dìgěi tǎ wéi yígè wánzhěng de , zìjǐ guādiào hēidǐ , suìxiè luò jìn tān biān de pò pén .
pairs.english: She handed Tavi a whole one, scraped the black bottom off her own, and the crumbs fell into a broken basin beside the stall.
pairs.hanzi: 她递给塔维一个完整的，自己刮掉黑底，碎屑落进摊边的破盆。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi pěng zhe bǐng , méiyǒu mǎshàng chī .
pairs.english: Tavi held the flatbread without eating at once.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维捧着饼，没有马上吃。

pairs.target: shuǐmiàn shàng , yìtiáo chuán líàn tài jìn , chuángōng yòng chēnggān dǐzhù shíbì , mànmàn bǎ chuántóu tuīkāi .
pairs.english: On the water a boat was much too close to the bank; the boatman used a pole to brace against the stone wall and slowly pushed its bow away.
pairs.hanzi: 水面上，一条船离岸太近，船工用撑杆抵住石壁，慢慢把船头推开。

pairs.target: tā de tóngbàn dūn zài lìngyìtóu hù zhe huò , zuǐlǐ hái zài jiáo dōngxī .
pairs.english: His companion crouched at the other end guarding the cargo, still chewing something in his mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 他的同伴蹲在另一头护着货，嘴里还在嚼东西。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hūrán xiǎngdào nà gūniáng de liǎngzhī píngzi .
pairs.english: Tavi suddenly thought of the girl's two bottles.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忽然想到那姑娘的两只瓶子。

pairs.target: nàxiē huà zài zhǐ shàng hěn xì de xiàn , yuánlái yě yǒu zhèyàng kuān , kuān dào yào yígè rén zhàn zài zhè tóu , lìng yígè rén zhàn zài nà tóu .
pairs.english: Those lines drawn so thin on paper were actually this wide too: wide enough to need one person standing at this end and another person standing at that end.
pairs.hanzi: 那些画在纸上很细的线，原来也有这样宽，宽到要一个人站在这头，另一个人站在那头。

pairs.target: " tú shàng zěnme huà chēngchuán de rén ? "
pairs.english: “How do you draw the people poling boats on the map?”
pairs.hanzi: “图上怎么画撑船的人？”

pairs.target: nài lěi zhèngzài gēn yíkuài guā bú xiàlái de jiāopí jiàojìn , tīng le biàn tái yǎnkàn tā .
pairs.english: Nerai was struggling with a piece of burnt crust she could not scrape off; hearing this, she looked up at him.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾正在跟一块刮不下来的焦皮较劲，听了便抬眼看他。

pairs.target: " nǐ xiǎng bǎ rén yě huà jìnqù ? "
pairs.english: “Do you want to put the people in the drawing too?”
pairs.hanzi: “你想把人也画进去？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuōbùqīng .
pairs.english: Tavi could not explain.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说不清。

pairs.target: tā búshì yào huàliǎn , zhǐshì nàtiáo xiàn ruò méi rén tuī chuán , gēn yǒurén de shíhòu sìhū bù yíyàng .
pairs.english: He did not mean to draw faces; it was just that if nobody pushed the boat, that line seemed different from when someone did.
pairs.hanzi: 他不是要画脸，只是那条线若没人推船，跟有人的时候似乎不一样。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ jiāopí fàngxià , cháo shuǐmiàn kàn le hǎo yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Nerai put the burnt crust down and looked toward the water for quite a while.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把焦皮放下，朝水面看了好一会儿。

pairs.target: " huàn gèrén chēng , zǒu de yě wèibì yíyàng . "
pairs.english: “With a different person poling, the passage may not be the same either.”
pairs.hanzi: “换个人撑，走的也未必一样。”

pairs.target: tā shuō yǐqián wèn guò yíduàn shuǐlù , sāngè rén gěi le sāngè shuōfǎ .
pairs.english: She said that once she had asked about a stretch of waterway and three people gave three different accounts.
pairs.hanzi: 她说以前问过一段水路，三个人给了三个说法。

pairs.target: qízhōng yígè xián tā wèn de fán , jiào tā zìjǐ shàngchuán zuò yítàng .
pairs.english: One of them found her questions annoying and told her to get on a boat herself for a trip.
pairs.hanzi: 其中一个嫌她问得烦，叫她自己上船坐一趟。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn tā zuò le méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether she had taken the trip.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问她坐了没有。

pairs.target: " zuò le . "
pairs.english: “I did.”
pairs.hanzi: “坐了。”

pairs.target: " hòulái ne ? "
pairs.english: “And afterwards?”
pairs.hanzi: “后来呢？”

pairs.target: " hòulái tā jiào wǒ bāng zhe xièhuò . "
pairs.english: “Afterwards he made me help unload the cargo.”
pairs.hanzi: “后来他叫我帮着卸货。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ bǐng fānguòlái , zhōngyú yǎo xià yídàkǒu .
pairs.english: She turned the flatbread over and finally bit off a big mouthful.
pairs.hanzi: 她把饼翻过来，终于咬下一大口。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào zhe chī zìjǐ de , rèqì tàng le shéjiān , yìshí lián huà yě shuōbùchūlái .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed as he ate his own; the heat scalded the tip of his tongue, and for a moment he could not even speak.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑着吃自己的，热气烫了舌尖，一时连话也说不出来。

pairs.target: chuánshàng de rén bǎ chēnggān shōu hǎo , liǎnggè rén gè ná yìtóu , jiāng cháng mùbǎn dā dào ànshàng .
pairs.english: The people on the boat stowed the pole; then the two of them took one end each and laid a long plank across to the bank.
pairs.hanzi: 船上的人把撑杆收好，两个人各拿一头，将长木板搭到岸上。

pairs.target: xiānqián dūn zhe de nàge zhàn qǐlái , wānyāo shìleshì bǎnzǐ , cái huíshēn bào huò .
pairs.english: The one who had been crouching stood up, bent to test the plank, and only then turned back to lift the cargo.
pairs.hanzi: 先前蹲着的那个站起来，弯腰试了试板子，才回身抱货。

pairs.target: nài lěi kànzhe tāmen , liǎnshàng de xiàoyì jiànjiàn dàn xiàlái , què bú xiàng bù gāoxìng .
pairs.english: Nerai watched them, the smile on her face gradually fading, though she did not seem unhappy.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾看着他们，脸上的笑意渐渐淡下来，却不像不高兴。

pairs.target: " xià huíjiàn wéi lǎoshī , wǒ xiǎng wènwèn , yǒuméiyǒu nǎ yítàng duǎnchéng , néng ràng nǐ gēnzhe zuò wán . "
pairs.english: “Next time we see Instructor Vey, I want to ask whether there is some short trip that would allow you to join and work through to the end.”
pairs.hanzi: “下回见维老师，我想问问，有没有哪一趟短程，能让你跟着做完。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shǒulǐ de bǐng tíngzhù le .
pairs.english: In his hand, Tavi’s flatbread stopped moving.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维手里的饼停住了。

pairs.target: " búshì zhàn pángbiān kànkàn ? "
pairs.english: “Not just standing at the side and watching?”
pairs.hanzi: “不是站旁边看看？”

pairs.target: " děi yǒu nǐ zhēn néng zuò de shì . "
pairs.english: “There would have to be something you really could do.”
pairs.hanzi: “得有你真能做的事。”

pairs.target: tā méi tì lǎoshī dāying , yě méi shuō qù nǎér , zhī wèn tǎ wéi yuànbuyuànyì xiān bǎ zhège xiǎngfǎ dàihuíqù tán .
pairs.english: She did not agree on the instructor's behalf, nor say where to go, only asked whether Tavi was willing first to take this idea back to discuss.
pairs.hanzi: 她没替老师答应，也没说去哪儿，只问塔维愿不愿意先把这个想法带回去谈。

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu tài kuài , zuǐlǐ de bǐng hái méi yànxià , xiǎnxiē yòu tàng le yícì .
pairs.english: He nodded too quickly, the flatbread still unswallowed in his mouth, and almost scalded himself once again.
pairs.hanzi: 他点头太快，嘴里的饼还没咽下，险些又烫了一次。

pairs.target: nài lěi xiào zhe ràng tā màndiǎn , lǎoshī yòu búhuì zài zhèhuìer zǒu guòlái .
pairs.english: Smiling, Nerai told him to slow down; after all, the instructor was not going to walk over just now.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾笑着让他慢点，老师又不会在这会儿走过来。

pairs.target: tāmen chī wán cái wǎnghuí zǒu , yántú méiyǒu zài tānkāi tú .
pairs.english: Only after they finished eating did they head back; along the way they did not spread the map out again.
pairs.hanzi: 他们吃完才往回走，沿途没有再摊开图。

pairs.target: dào le xuégōng ménkǒu , tǎ wéi wèn xiàhuí tán zhīqián , néng bunéng xiān ràng mǐlā hé yīwén tīngtīng .
pairs.english: At the academy gate Tavi asked whether, before the next discussion, he could first let Mira and Iven hear about it.
pairs.hanzi: 到了学宫门口，塔维问下回谈之前，能不能先让米拉和伊文听听。

pairs.target: " zhè shì nǐ de shì . "
pairs.english: “This is your business.”
pairs.hanzi: “这是你的事。”

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ zhǐjuǎn wǎng jiānshàng nuó wěn .
pairs.english: Nerai securely shifted the paper roll onto her shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把纸卷往肩上挪稳。

pairs.target: " biéshuō chéng yǐjīng dìng le jiù xíng . "
pairs.english: “Just don't say it has already been settled.”
pairs.hanzi: “别说成已经定了就行。”

pairs.target: tā dāyingxiàlái , jìnmén hòu què méiyǒu lìkè qù zhǎo rén .
pairs.english: He agreed, but after going through the gate did not immediately look for anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 他答应下来，进门后却没有立刻去找人。

pairs.target: tā xiān zài ménnèi zhàn le yìxiǎo huìer , děng xīntiào mànxiàlái , cái wǎng tāmen cháng zuò de chuāng biān zǒu .
pairs.english: He first stood inside the gate a little while, waited for his heartbeat to slow, and only then walked toward the window where they often sat.
pairs.hanzi: 他先在门内站了一小会儿，等心跳慢下来，才往他们常坐的窗边走。
